name: tandem
description: Tandem, a collaborative text editor in Lean: Fugue's sequence CRDT, a sync server and a Lasm.UI editor that works offline, compiled to WebAssembly by Lasm, with proofs

scripts.build: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerNode.lean --output dist/server
scripts.build:bun: npm run build:client && bunx --bun lasm build ServerBun.lean --target bun
scripts.build:deno: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerDeno.lean --target deno
scripts.build:workers: npm run build:client && lasm build ServerWorkers.lean --target workers
scripts.build:docker: npm run build && docker build -t tandem .
